title: The Via Club at Pebble Creek

services.name: Via Club Rental
services.desc: Pebble Creek homeowners may rent the full facility two (2) times per calendar year. The homeowner rate is for immediate family members living at the residence only holding an event for someone living at the residence, otherwise sponsorship rates apply for events for other family members, friends and corporate/sports parties. Company and for-profit events do not fall under the homeowner rate. In an effort to keep homeowner dues to a minimum, we ask that you please respect this policy. If it is determined that the guidelines for the pricing structure have not been adhered to or have been misrepresented (homeowner vs. sponsored rental), then the rental will convert to the same pricing

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: ​​If you need to purchase a gym access card after hours, you may drop off payment in the mail slot to the right of the front door at the clubhouse. Please make a notation of what you are purchasing on your check or on a separate note. Your card will be processed the next business day and placed in the pick-up box on the column outside the front door.
